sourceFile: 68. TIU C11-20 Report test Change Dry IR  2026.3.3_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the Dry IR time change but misgroups several Normal/test comparisons and includes an invalid measurement outcome.
issues: Rows 18 and 22 are compared to row 16 instead of their same-date Normal rows 20 and 24.
Frame/sticky rows 32 and 33 should be paired; draft compares row 32 to row 31.
3'62 frame result should be no worse/no NG, not improved versus the 2/9 Normal row.
Measurement outcome is derived from header-only row 13 and should be removed.
Changed factor should be Dry IR time reduction; line/model and actual times are subgroup context.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to Dry IR spec/time changed from 4~5 min to 3~4 min.
Pair function results by date/trial: 14 vs 16, 18 vs 20, and 22 vs 24.
Pair frame/sticky results by date/trial: 30 vs 31 and 32 vs 33.
Revise judgements to reflect function improvement and 3'07 frame/sticky worsening with 3'62 acceptable.
Remove the header-based measurement outcome; keep tension only as summary if cited to row 47.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited comparison rows are not sufficient until same-date pairings are corrected.
